Project 2: Student Grade Calculator

⏱ 60 minNeeds: conditions, loops, methods, validation

1 Milestones (in order)

  1. Read 5 marks (0–100) with validation loop
  2. Compute total + average in methods
  3. Map average to A/B/C/D/F
  4. Print a neat report

3 Tests your app must pass

  • marks [90,80,70] → avg 80 → B
  • -5 or 105 is rejected and asked again
  • empty input handled

4 Hints, then solution

Stuck?

Re-read the linked lessons, trace one milestone on paper, test with the simplest input.

HintsSplit into the smallest milestone. Hardcode one example, then generalize. Print intermediate values.
Guided solutionKeep reading until valid. average() sums then divides by length as double. gradeFor(avg) uses if-else chain. Test edges 0, 59/60, 100.
